value.rationale: The strict, progress-erasing all-searchers-within-one-reset-epoch task is a natural synchronized quorum/parallel completion objective. It exhibits a singular design distinction: any fixed common reset rate costs exp(const \(N^{2/3}\)), but a globally optimized clock of order \(N^{-2}\) reduces the best achievable mean to order \(N^2\) with an explicit universal variational constant. This is a meaningful exact population-scale optimization and boundary, not merely a numerical benchmark or renaming of one-searcher renewal theory.
